title: Open Document Spec (ODS) Frontmatter Schema
description: Frontmatter metadata validation schema for Open Document Spec Markdown files.

ods.description: Spec version marker (e.g. '0.1'). Required on workspace root index.md.

profile.description: Document profile catalog schema (e.g. index, note, feature, guide, policy, rfc, postmortem).

title.description: Document title override (optional; H1 heading preferred).

tags.description: Taxonomy tags associated with this document.

related.description: Related document IDs for context expansion.

share.description: Access control and pack export visibility.

custom-profiles.description: Custom profile catalog files registered on root index.md.

packs.description: Exported or imported ODS document pack paths.

ignore.description: Workspace file or folder ignore patterns.
